```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
grades <- levels(metadata$tumor_grade)
pairs <- combn(grades, 2, simplify = FALSE)

contrast_names <- sapply(
  pairs,
  function(p) paste0(p[2], "_ vs _", p[1])
)

contrast_strings <- sapply(
  pairs,
  function(p) paste0(p[2], "-", p[1])
)

contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(contrasts = contrast_strings, levels = design)
colnames(contrast_matrix) <- contrast_names

fit <- lmFit(v, design)
fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

master_deg_list <- list()
all_list <- list()
up_list <- list()
down_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(contrast_names)) {

  cn <- contrast_names[i]

  cat("\n===========================\nProcessing contrast:", cn,
      "\n===========================\n")

  tt <- topTable(fit2,
                 coef = i,
                 number = Inf,
                 sort.by = "none")

  gene_names <- rownames(tt)
res_df <- data.frame(
    gene = gene_names,
    log2FoldChange = tt$logFC,
    lfcSE = fit2$stdev.unscaled[, i] * fit2$sigma,
    AveExpr = tt$AveExpr,
    stat = tt$t,
    pvalue = tt$P.Value,
    padj = tt$adj.P.Val,
    B = tt$B,
    baseMean = rowMeans(norm_counts[gene_names, , drop = FALSE]),
    contrast = cn,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

res_sig <- res_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj < 0.05)

  cat("Significant genes (padj < 0.05):", nrow(res_sig), "\n")

write.csv(res_df,
            paste0("D:/limma/DE_limma_full_", cn, ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  write.csv(res_sig,
            paste0("D:/limma/DE_limma_sig_", cn, ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
up_genes <- res_sig %>%
    filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>%
    mutate(contrast = cn)

  down_genes <- res_sig %>%
    filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>%
    mutate(contrast = cn)

  write.csv(up_genes,
            paste0("D:/limma/UP_genes_", cn, ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

  write.csv(down_genes,
            paste0("D:/limma/DOWN_genes_", cn, ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)

png(paste0("D:/limma/MA_plot_limma_", cn, ".png"),
      width = 1800, height = 1200, res = 200)
  plotMD(fit2,
         column = i,
         status = res_df$padj < 0.05,
         main = paste0("MA Plot (limma: ", cn, ")"))
  abline(h = 0, col = "blue")
  dev.off()

volcano_df <- res_df %>%
    mutate(
      padj_plot = ifelse(is.na(padj), NA, pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)),
      neglog10padj = -log10(padj_plot)
    )

  volcano <- ggplot(volcano_df) +
    geom_point(aes(x = log2FoldChange,
                   y = neglog10padj,
                   color = padj < 0.05),
               alpha = 0.6) +
    theme_bw() +
    ggtitle(paste0("Volcano Plot (limma: ", cn, ")")) +
    xlab("log2 fold change") +
    ylab("-log10 adjusted p-value") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  ggsave(paste0("D:/limma/Volcano_plot_limma_", cn, ".png"),
         plot = volcano, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

  # Heatmap for Top 50 DEGs
  top_genes <- res_sig %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    slice_head(n = 50) %>%
    pull(gene)

  if (length(top_genes) >= 10) {
    mat_top <- vsd_mat[top_genes, , drop = FALSE]

    png(paste0("D:/limma/Heatmap_", cn, "_top_DEGs.png"),
        width = 1500, height = 1200, res = 200)

    pheatmap(mat_top,
             scale = "row",
             annotation_col = ann_col,
             fontsize_row = 7,
             main = paste("Top 50 DEGs Heatmap:", cn))

    dev.off()
  }

  # Heatmap for all significant genes
  if (nrow(res_sig) > 1) {
    sig_genes <- res_sig$gene
    sig_expr <- vsd_mat[sig_genes, , drop = FALSE]
    sig_expr <- sig_expr[rowVars(sig_expr) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

    if (nrow(sig_expr) > 1) {
      pheatmap(
        sig_expr,
        scale = "row",
        show_rownames = FALSE,
        cluster_rows = TRUE,
        annotation_col = ann_col,
        color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "YlOrRd"))(100),
        filename = paste0("D:/limma/Heatmap_limma_sig_genes_", cn, ".png"),
        width = 10,
        height = 8
      )
    }
  }

  master_deg_list[[cn]] <- res_df
  all_list[[cn]] <- res_df
  up_list[[cn]] <- up_genes
  down_list[[cn]] <- down_genes
}


```

# ---------- Enrichment ----------
outdir_enrich <- "D:/limma/ENRICHMENT"
dir.create(outdir_enrich, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

run_enrichment <- function(genes, label, prefix) {

  genes <- unique(na.omit(genes))
  if (length(genes) < 10) return(NULL)

  # GO BP
  ego <- enrichGO(
    gene = genes,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "SYMBOL",
    ont = "BP",
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    readable = TRUE
  )

  ego_df <- as.data.frame(ego)
  if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(ego_df) > 0) {
    write.csv(ego_df,
              file.path(outdir_enrich, paste0(prefix, "_GO_", label, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)

    png(file.path(outdir_enrich, paste0(prefix, "_GO_", label, ".png")),
        width = 1500, height = 1000, res = 200)
    print(dotplot(ego, showCategory = 20) +
            ggtitle(paste(prefix, "GO BP -", label)))
    dev.off()
  }

  # KEGG
  entrez <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                   keys = genes,
                   column = "ENTREZID",
                   keytype = "SYMBOL",
                   multiVals = "first") |> na.omit()

  entrez <- unique(entrez)
  if (length(entrez) < 10) return(NULL)

  ekegg <- enrichKEGG(
    gene = entrez,
    organism = "hsa"
  )

  ekegg_df <- as.data.frame(ekegg)
  if (!is.null(ekegg) && nrow(ekegg_df) > 0) {
    write.csv(ekegg_df,
              file.path(outdir_enrich, paste0(prefix, "_KEGG_", label, ".csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)

    png(file.path(outdir_enrich, paste0(prefix, "_KEGG_", label, ".png")),
        width = 1500, height = 1000, res = 200)
    print(dotplot(ekegg, showCategory = 20) +
            ggtitle(paste(prefix, "KEGG -", label)))
    dev.off()
  }
}

# ---------- Pairwise enrichment using UP and DOWN files ----------
deg_files <- list.files("D:/limma",
                        pattern = "^UP_|^DOWN_",
                        full.names = TRUE)

for (f in deg_files) {

  df <- read.csv(f)
  genes <- df$gene

  label <- ifelse(grepl("^UP_", basename(f)), "UP", "DOWN")

  contrast <- gsub(".csv", "", basename(f))
  contrast <- gsub("^UP_|^DOWN_", "", contrast)

  prefix <- paste0("PAIRWISE_", contrast)

  run_enrichment(genes, label, prefix)
}

# ---------- Biological enrichment ----------
bio_up <- read.csv("D:/limma/Biological_UP_genes_sorted.csv")
bio_down <- read.csv("D:/limma/Biological_DOWN_genes_sorted.csv")

run_enrichment(bio_up$gene, "UP", "BIOLOGICAL")
run_enrichment(bio_down$gene, "DOWN", "BIOLOGICAL")

# ---------- Combined enrichment ----------
comb_up <- read.csv("D:/limma/Combined_UP_genes_sorted.csv")
comb_down <- read.csv("D:/limma/Combined_DOWN_genes_sorted.csv")

run_enrichment(comb_up$gene, "UP", "COMBINED")
run_enrichment(comb_down$gene, "DOWN", "COMBINED")

cat("\nALL GO + KEGG ENRICHMENTS COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY\n")

# ---------- Stage progression genes ----------
grade_means <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(vsd_mat),
  sapply(grades, function(g) {
    idx <- metadata$tumor_grade == g
    if (sum(idx) >= 2) {
      rowMeans(vsd_mat[, idx, drop = FALSE])
    } else {
      rep(NA, nrow(vsd_mat))
    }
  }),
  check.names = FALSE
)

expr_mat <- as.matrix(grade_means[, -1])

stage_prog <- grade_means[
  apply(expr_mat, 1, function(x) {
    x <- x[!is.na(x)]
    length(x) >= 2 &&
      (all(diff(x) > 0) || all(diff(x) < 0))
  }),
]

write.csv(stage_prog,
          "D:/limma/Stage_progression_genes.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nLIMMA-VOOM PIPELINE COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY\n")
